rule: a raw NUL byte in a string
why: THE RAW BYTE SCAN. The fixture is `Buffer.from`-built rather than typed, because a NUL byte does not survive being typed through an editing tool, the same reason the gate's own header insists on it for anyone seeding a case here. One finding: a NUL sitting inside a string literal, the shape of both real defects this gate was written for.
